id_policy: Zero-based IDs assigned by exact-name alphabetical order for version 1.0.0. Preserve existing IDs and append new IDs in future compatible versions.
name_policy: Exact annotation labels; case-sensitive. No synonym merging, translation, or relabeling.
counts_definition: interval_count counts action records; video_count counts unique source video IDs per class. A video may contain several classes.
annotation_hashes_definition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 lines video_id + TAB + annotation_sha256 + NEWLINE, sorted by video_id.
